channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: High-calorie diet causes brain nerve abnormalities, researchers find
item.description: A team in Japan has found that a cognitive decline from continually eating high-calorie food is due to abnormalities in the synapses.

item.title: Japan raises alert for parts of Saudi Arabia, discouraging nonessential travel
item.description: Following the change, the entire country of Saudi Arabia is under Level 2 or higher in the Foreign Ministry's four-tier travel alert scale.

item.title: Turkish-Japanese science university opens in Ankara
item.description: At Turkish-Japanese Science and Technology University, about 100 Turkish students will study artificial intelligence, earthquakes and other fields.

item.title: MUFG wades back into Japanese bonds with eye on policy risks
item.description: The bank remains concerned that yields could further spike due to fiscal and monetary policies in the nation.

item.title: Russia arrests Japanese journalist on spying charges
item.description: The Hokkaido Shimbun journalist is accused of collecting information on Moscow's defence capabilities for Tokyo.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
